osm_report.threat_description:
VS Code autorun dropper. Payload in .vscode/tasks.json.
Outbound: fetch-and-run. It downloads code from aitech.s.gy and executes it (.vscode/tasks.json).
Runs automatically when the folder is opened in VS Code (hidden folderOpen task that fetches and runs a remote script).
Matches PolinRider / Contagious Interview (DPRK): fake-recruiter coding tasks that run a downloader when opened in VS Code. Payload host: aitech.s.gy.
Attribution: the tradecraft is consistent with North Korea, but a single signal is a lead rather than an attribution, so we do not attribute it on this evidence alone. Signals: Delivery vector matches Contagious-Interview tradecraft: vscode-folderopen-autorun; Corroboration (not counted toward attribution): OSM/news already names dprk (north korea).
Confirmed by static analysis; the code was read, never executed.
osm_report.payload_description:
Malicious payload found in: .vscode/tasks.json
- Outbound: fetch-and-run. It downloads code from aitech.s.gy and executes it (.vscode/tasks.json).
- .vscode/tasks.json: VS Code task with runOn: folderOpen; runs the moment the folder is opened, no install or click needed
- Attacker hosts: aitech.s.gy
